meaning.hi: सब प्राणियों का पालन करने वाला

meaning.en: consecrated as sovereign of the kingdom of yoga
the teacher, in a private place
the yoga with its eight limbs

meaning.hi: जिसे केवल समझ लेने भर से

meaning.en: the yoga that shows itself through eight limbs
meaning.hi: आठ अंगों के रूप में दिखने वाला योग

meaning.en: after that, drawing-in of the senses
not taking what is not yours
apart from the way the Veda prescribes
meaning.hi: वेद द्वारा बताए ढंग के अलावा

meaning.en: that is declared the highest non-harm
meaning.hi: वही सर्वोच्च अहिंसा कही गई है

meaning.en: through the eyes and the other senses
is the highest reality, the one truth
that is declared the highest truthfulness
by those who have crossed to the far shore of Vedanta knowledge
the turning back of the mind
with the attitude of the not-Self
the giving up of all such dealing
that is what is called not-stealing
by those who know the Self
is sexual discipline in its highest sense
of one and the same form
that is what I call straightforwardness
the absence of agitation in the understanding
release from the round of birth and death
is called steadiness by the followers of the Veda

words.sanskrit: aham atma na cha anyah asmi

meaning.en: I am the Self and nothing other
in a way that supports yoga
removing the dirt of one's own body
the wise know reflection as the inner cleanliness
meaning.hi: मानसिक शौच को मनन जानते हैं
यह ज्ञान कि मैं शुद्ध हूँ

meaning.en: and the one who lives in the body
having known the difference between the two
whose cleanliness is there to prescribe
setting aside the cleanliness that comes from knowledge
the man who delights in the outer kind
meaning.hi: जो मनुष्य बाहरी में रमता है

meaning.en: he picks up a clod of earth
of one satisfied by the nectar of knowledge
of the yogi who has done all that needed doing
there is nothing further to be done
he does not know the reality
there is nothing whatever to be done
for those who know the Self
meaning.hi: आत्मा को जानने वालों के लिए

meaning.en: using non-harm and the other restraints as tools
not merely from hearing about it
faith in what the scriptures teach
and listening to the settled teachings
by the method laid down in the Veda
through penances such as the krichchhra and chandrayana fasts
that is what is called austerity
has one arrived in this world of change
those who know the meaning of things
from whatever comes on its own
meaning.hi: जो अपने आप मिल जाए उससे

meaning.en: the delight that arises in people
meaning.hi: लोगों में जो प्रसन्नता उपजती है

meaning.en: from everything up to the world of Brahma
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा के लोक तक की हर चीज़ से

meaning.en: they know as the highest contentment
trust in the Vedas and the law-books
to a person who lives by the Veda
meaning.hi: वेद के मार्ग पर चलने वाले व्यक्ति को
या जो कुछ और दिया जाए

meaning.en: a heart free of craving and the like
untainted by untruth and the like
action free of harm and the like
that is worship of the Lord
in the ways of the Veda and of the world
meaning.hi: वेद और लोक के मार्गों में

meaning.en: the shame that arises toward it
meaning.hi: उसके प्रति जो लज्जा उठती है

meaning.en: faith in all that belongs to the Veda
even as taught by the teacher
free of any selfish tie to it
meaning.hi: उसमें स्वार्थ के सम्बन्ध से रहित

meaning.en: by the very method the Veda states
meaning.hi: वेद में कहे मार्ग से ही

meaning.en: is said to be of two kinds
meaning.hi: दो प्रकार का कहा गया है
और मानस, मन में किया जाने वाला
दो प्रकार का कहा गया है

meaning.en: by the division into reflection and meditation
meaning.hi: मनन और ध्यान के भेद से

meaning.en: is said to be a thousand times greater

meaning.hi: ऊँचे स्वर का जप सबके लिए
कहे अनुसार फल देने वाला होता है

meaning.en: the hero's pose and the lion's seat
and the one named the easy pose
placing between the knees and thighs
meaning.hi: घुटनों और जाँघों के बीच रखकर

meaning.en: with neck, head and body in one line
meaning.hi: गर्दन, सिर और शरीर को सीधा रखे हुए

meaning.en: should place at the side of the back
and the left likewise on the right
meaning.hi: और बायाँ उसी तरह दाईं ओर

meaning.en: that they call the cow-face pose
should grasp up to the big toes

meaning.hi: उलटे क्रम से, बाँहें आड़ी करके

meaning.en: which removes the fear of every illness
meaning.hi: सब रोगों का भय हरने वाला

meaning.en: the foot other than the right
should set on the right thigh
the two ankles below the genitals
should set on both sides of the perineum
and the feet at the sides with the hands
meaning.hi: और बगल के पैरों को हाथों से
मज़बूती से बाँधकर, पूरी तरह निश्चल

meaning.en: with the heel other than the right
meaning.hi: दाएँ के अलावा वाली एड़ी से

meaning.en: this is the pose of release
placing above the organ of generation
and drawing in the space between the heels
meaning.hi: और एड़ियों के बीच की दूरी सिकोड़कर

meaning.en: this is the pose of release, sage
should set at the sides of the navel
with head and feet raised high
meaning.hi: सिर और पैर ऊँचे उठाए हुए
सब पापों का नाश करने वाला
सुख और धैर्य उत्पन्न होते हैं

meaning.en: that is called the easy pose
by whom posture has been mastered
by him the three worlds are won
the body is just so much
in the middle of the body

meaning.hi: तपे हुए सोने जैसी चमक वाला

meaning.en: nine finger-breadths from the root centre

meaning.hi: मुर्ग़ी के अण्डे जैसे आकार का

meaning.en: with skin and the other layers
the channel in the middle of the bulb
meaning.hi: कन्द के मध्य में स्थित नाड़ी

meaning.en: and likewise Ida, the left channel
meaning.hi: और उसी तरह इडा, बाईं नाड़ी

meaning.en: of them, three are most important
among the three, one is highest of all
it is called the channel of Brahman
with the bone in the middle of the back
meaning.hi: पीठ के बीच में स्थित हड्डी के साथ

meaning.en: the staff shaped like a vina's neck
meaning.hi: वीणा की डंडी जैसे दण्ड से

meaning.en: having the form of eightfold nature
meaning.hi: आठ प्रकार की प्रकृति के रूप वाली

meaning.en: the movement of the vital air
water, food and the rest, continually
all around the sides of the bulb
meaning.hi: कन्द के किनारों पर चारों ओर
उन्हें रोके हुए सदा स्थित रहती है

meaning.en: the opening of the passage to Brahman
Ida on the left of Sushumna
are placed at the two sides of Sushumna
meaning.hi: सुषुम्ना के दोनों ओर स्थित हैं

meaning.en: at the back and side of Ida
meaning.hi: इडा के पीछे और बगल में

meaning.en: behind and in front of Pingala
running from the middle of the bulb
meaning.hi: कन्द के बीच से जाने वाली

meaning.en: in the front part of Sushumna
meaning.hi: सुषुम्ना के आगे वाले भाग में

meaning.en: Kuhu is placed toward the organ of generation
meaning.hi: कुहू जननेन्द्रिय की ओर स्थित है

meaning.en: the channel stretched from below upward
meaning.hi: नीचे से ऊपर तक फैली नाड़ी

meaning.en: is held to end at the right nostril
meaning.hi: दाएँ नथुने तक मानी जाती है

meaning.en: Ida, up to the left nostril
to the tip of the left big toe
meaning.hi: बाएँ पैर के अँगूठे के सिरे तक

meaning.en: Pusha, as far as the left eye
to the end of the right ear

meaning.hi: सरस्वती उसी तरह ऊपर जाती हुई

meaning.en: to the tip of the left big toe
meaning.hi: बाएँ पैर के अँगूठे के सिरे तक

meaning.en: is held to end at the left ear
meaning.hi: बाएँ कान तक मानी जाती है

meaning.en: Gandhara, ending at the left eye
as declared by the knowers of Vedanta
meaning.hi: वेदान्त के ज्ञाताओं द्वारा कही गई

meaning.en: is settled in the middle of the bulb
meaning.hi: कन्द के बीच में स्थित है
प्राण, अपान और उसी तरह व्यान

meaning.en: among them, the five beginning with prana
the one called prana, and apana
of the two, prana is to be honoured
between the mouth and the nose
in the centre of the navel and in the heart
meaning.hi: नाभि के बीच में और हृदय में

meaning.en: in the anus, the lower middle, the thighs and knees
meaning.hi: गुदा, मध्य भाग, जाँघों और घुटनों में

meaning.en: in the hips, at the navel
vyana, between the ears and eyes
meaning.hi: व्यान कानों और आँखों के बीच

meaning.en: in the shoulders and the ankles too
in prana's seat and in the throat
meaning.hi: प्राण के स्थान में और गले में

meaning.en: the one called udana is to be known
meaning.hi: उदान नाम वाला जानने योग्य है

meaning.en: in the feet and in the hands too
meaning.hi: पैरों में और हाथों में भी

meaning.en: the five airs beginning with naga
are placed in the skin, bones and the rest
meaning.hi: त्वचा, हड्डी आदि में स्थित हैं

meaning.en: breathing out, breathing in and coughing
are indeed the work of prana
the discharge of faeces, urine and the like
does indeed bring about, no doubt
vyana is said to cause opposed effort
meaning.hi: व्यान विरोधी प्रयास करने वाला कहा गया है

meaning.en: belching and the like are declared the property
meaning.hi: डकार आदि गुण कहा गया है

meaning.en: of dhananjaya, the glow and the like
closing of the eyes and the like, of kurma
of Sushumna, the god is Shiva
of Ida, the deity is Hari
Pushan is declared the presiding deity of Pusha
meaning.hi: पूषा के अधिदेवता पूषन् कहे गए हैं

meaning.en: Varuna has the wind as its deity
of Kuhu, hunger is declared the deity
meaning.hi: कुहू की देवता भूख कही गई है

meaning.en: Gandhari has the moon as deity
O best of the knowers of the Veda
the crossing over of the breath
that is called the northward course

meaning.hi: पिंगला में, ऐसा श्रुति कहती है

meaning.en: the junction of Ida and Pingala
then it is called the new moon
meaning.hi: तब उसे अमावस्या कहा जाता है

meaning.en: when prana has entered the root centre
meaning.hi: जब प्राण मूलाधार में प्रवेश कर गया हो

meaning.en: that is called the first equinox
meaning.hi: उसे पहला विषुव कहा गया है

meaning.en: when it entered the crown of the head
meaning.hi: जब सिर के शिखर में प्रवेश कर गया

meaning.en: that is called the last equinox
meaning.hi: उसे अन्तिम विषुव कहा गया है

meaning.en: by ascetics who reflect on reality
meaning.hi: तत्त्व का चिन्तन करने वाले तपस्वियों द्वारा

meaning.en: is the turning of the months
by way of Ida, to the seat of Kundalini
meaning.hi: इडा से कुण्डलिनी के स्थान तक

meaning.en: it is called an eclipse of the moon
O best of the knowers of reality
when the breath, by way of Pingala
has come to the seat of Kundalini
meaning.hi: कुण्डलिनी के स्थान पर आ गया

meaning.en: there is an eclipse of the sun
Shri Parvata at the top of the head
between the eyebrows and the nose
Kurukshetra in the region of the breast
Prayaga in the lotus of the heart
Chidambaram in the centre of the heart
abandoning the holy place of the Self
whoever goes to outer holy places
meaning.hi: जो बाहरी तीर्थों में जाता है

meaning.en: he, the great jewel in his hand
meaning.hi: वह हाथ में रखे महारत्न को

meaning.en: the holy place of feeling is the highest
meaning.hi: भाव का तीर्थ परम तीर्थ है

meaning.en: a wife is embraced one way
meaning.hi: पत्नी को एक तरह गले लगाया जाता है

meaning.en: a daughter is embraced another way
meaning.hi: बेटी को दूसरी तरह गले लगाया जाता है

meaning.en: gods made of wood and the like
because of trust in their own Self
meaning.hi: अपने आत्मा में विश्वास के कारण

meaning.en: higher than the outer holy place
the Self is the great holy place
any other holy place is purposeless
is not purified by baths at holy places
even washed a hundred times with water
meaning.hi: सौ बार पानी से धोया हुआ भी

meaning.en: stays impure like a wine jar
meaning.hi: शराब के बर्तन की तरह अशुद्ध

meaning.en: at the times of equinoxes and solstices
at eclipses, and always in between
meaning.hi: ग्रहण में और बीच में सदा

meaning.en: of those devoted to the yoga of knowledge
the water that washed their feet
for those who do not yet know
in holy fords, learning, prayer and sacrifice
meaning.hi: तीर्थ, ज्ञान, जप और यज्ञ में

meaning.en: in wood and in stone, always
the deluded one looks for Shiva
meaning.hi: मूढ़ व्यक्ति शिव को देखता है

meaning.en: while Shiva is seated in the body
meaning.hi: जबकि शिव शरीर में प्रतिष्ठित हैं
जो बाहर वाले की सेवा करता है

meaning.en: throwing away the food in his hand
they see Shiva in the Self
meaning.hi: शिव को आत्मा में देखते हैं

meaning.en: for the contemplation of those who do not know
Brahman with nothing before or beyond it
meaning.hi: जिसके न पहले कुछ, न पार कुछ, वह ब्रह्म

meaning.en: one's own Self, real and without a second
a mass of awareness, and bliss

meaning.hi: जो ऐसा देखता है, वही देखता है

words.sanskrit: atmana atmanam aham iti eva dharaya

meaning.en: through the Self, hold the Self alone as I
meaning.hi: आत्मा से आत्मा को ही मैं के रूप में धारण करो

meaning.en: the steady one does not grieve
destroyed by the strength of knowledge
meaning.hi: ज्ञान के बल से नष्ट होने पर

meaning.en: the difference between Self and Brahman
the purification of the channel of Brahman, in brief
I may become free while living
the cleansing of the channels, in brief
engaged in duties laid down by scripture
meaning.hi: विधि से कहे कर्मों में लगा हुआ

meaning.en: free from desire and its schemes
joined with the eight limbs beginning with restraint
meaning.hi: यम आदि आठ अंगों से युक्त

meaning.en: well settled in one's own Self
and well trained by those who know
on a mountain top, on a river bank
meaning.hi: पर्वत की चोटी पर, नदी के किनारे

meaning.en: at the foot of a bilva tree or in a forest
meaning.hi: बेल के पेड़ की जड़ में या वन में

meaning.en: having then taken up the seat

meaning.hi: पूर्व या उत्तर की ओर मुख करके

meaning.en: neck, head and body in line
at the tip of the nose
in the disc of the moon
the fourth state at the centre of the point
drawing the breath in through Ida
filling it into the belly, held there
then the fire in the middle of the body
meaning.hi: फिर शरीर के मध्य की अग्नि

meaning.en: joined with the dot and the resonance
should contemplate the seed-syllable of fire
the wise one, the breath through Pingala
should recall the seed-syllable of fire
the wise one should again exhale
six times, one should practise daily
at the three junctions of the day
obtains the cleansing of the channels
brightness of the fire in the belly
the manifesting of the inner sound
as long as he has not seen these
so long should he practise thus
meaning.hi: तब तक ऐसे ही अभ्यास करे

meaning.en: should practise the purifying of the Self
the Self is pure, always, eternal

meaning.hi: ज्ञान से यह शुद्ध होता है

meaning.en: the mire of the dirt of ignorance
not the other, absorbed in ritual
I shall tell the order of breath control
breath control is declared to be
by breathing out, breathing in and holding
said to be of the nature of three sounds
meaning.hi: तीन वर्णों के स्वरूप वाले कहे गए

meaning.en: breathing out, breathing in and holding
that is declared to be Om
breath control is made of it
drawing the air in through Ida
should keep the sound A in mind there
afterward should hold what was filled
meaning.hi: फिर भरे हुए को रोके रखे

meaning.en: here too, the form of U
as long as one is able
then should release what was filled
the wise one, the air, with the sound M
meaning.hi: बुद्धिमान, वायु को म-कार के साथ

meaning.en: and then one should practise it thus
meaning.hi: और फिर ऐसे ही अभ्यास करे

meaning.en: here too should keep the form of A in mind
meaning.hi: यहाँ भी अ-कार के रूप का स्मरण करे

meaning.en: the knowing one should hold what was filled
meditating on the form of U
meaning.hi: उ-कार के रूप का ध्यान करते हुए

meaning.en: then, keeping the sound M in mind
meaning.hi: फिर म-कार का स्मरण करते हुए

meaning.en: should release the air through Ida
in just this way should do again
the thoughtful one, filling through Ida
breath control, O lord of sages

meaning.hi: इस तरह रोज़ अभ्यास करने से

meaning.en: within six months one becomes truly skilled
meaning.hi: छह महीनों में कुशल हो जाता है

meaning.en: within a year one becomes a knower of Brahman
meaning.hi: एक वर्ष में ब्रह्मज्ञानी हो जाता है

meaning.en: always devoted to the practice of yoga
and who is devoted to his own duty
meaning.hi: और जो अपने धर्म में लगा है

meaning.en: by restraint of the breath alone
into the belly: that is inhalation
like a pot filled to the brim
from the belly, is known as exhalation

and rising they know as the highest
meaning.hi: और उठने को उत्तम जानते हैं

meaning.en: should keep doing each earlier stage

meaning.hi: जब तक उठना सम्भव न हो

meaning.en: the wise one becomes happy in breath control
meaning.hi: ज्ञानी प्राणायाम में सुखी होता है

meaning.en: becomes pure, you of good vows

meaning.en: the breath, joined with the mind

meaning.hi: और सफ़ेद बाल आदि नष्ट होते हैं

meaning.en: for one wholly devoted to breath control
nothing at all is hard to attain

at the two twilights, and before dawn
meaning.hi: दोनों सन्ध्याओं में और ब्रह्म-मुहूर्त में भी

meaning.en: at midday, or at any time
drawing in the breath from outside
and filling it into the belly
at the tip of the nose and the centre of the navel
meaning.hi: नाक के सिरे पर और नाभि के मध्य में

meaning.en: and at the big toes, one should hold it
meaning.hi: और पैर के अँगूठों पर धारण करे

meaning.en: a person lives a hundred years

meaning.hi: और नाक के सिरे पर धारण से

meaning.en: it is mastered, you of good vows
meaning.hi: वश में होता है, हे सुव्रत

meaning.en: there is an end of all illness
meaning.hi: सब रोगों की निवृत्ति होती है

meaning.en: from holding at the centre of the navel
meaning.hi: नाभि के मध्य में धारण से

meaning.en: from restraint at the big toe
meaning.hi: पैर के अँगूठे पर रोकने से

meaning.en: drawing in air with the tongue
the person who constantly drinks it
freed from weariness and burning heat
the yogi becomes free of disease
drawing in air with the tongue
should hold it at the root of the tongue
should hold it between the eyebrows

meaning.hi: वह रोगों से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: the knower of the Veda's essence, through Ida
should hold it at the navel
by this a person is freed from sickness
meaning.hi: उससे मनुष्य रोगों से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: for a month, at the three junctions of the day
meaning.hi: एक महीने तक, तीनों सन्धियों में

meaning.en: raising the air with the tongue
should hold it at the navel, gently, gently
disorders born of wind and bile
meaning.hi: वात और पित्त से उपजे दोष

meaning.en: should hold it at the two eyes
likewise by holding at the ears
meaning.hi: उसी तरह कानों पर रोकने से
उसी तरह वायु को ऊपर उठाकर

meaning.en: should hold it steady in the head
meaning.hi: सिर में स्थित करके धारण करे

meaning.en: ailments of the head are destroyed
meaning.hi: सिर के रोग नष्ट होते हैं

meaning.en: truly has it been said, Sankriti
meaning.hi: सच ही कहा गया है, सांकृति

meaning.en: should close firmly with the hands
the ears and the other sense organs
the ears with the thumbs, sage
with the fingers that close the nostrils
meaning.hi: नथुने बन्द करने वाली उँगलियों से
जब तक आनन्द प्रकट न हो

meaning.en: by holding in the crown for that long
meaning.hi: तब तक शिखर में धारण से

meaning.en: by this very means the breath goes
to the opening of Brahman, great sage
when the breath has entered the opening of Brahman
meaning.hi: वायु के ब्रह्मरन्ध्र में जाने पर

meaning.en: an inner sound arises, sinless one
meaning.hi: हे निष्पाप, नाद उत्पन्न होता है

meaning.en: at first like the sound of a conch
in the middle, like the rumble of a cloud
when the breath reaches the middle of the head
meaning.hi: वायु के सिर के मध्य में पहुँचने पर

meaning.en: like a torrent down a mountain
then the very wise one, delighted

meaning.hi: सीधे आत्मा की ओर उन्मुख होता है

meaning.en: through yoga, worldly existence is swallowed up
with the heel other than the left
meaning.hi: बाईं के अलावा वाली एड़ी से

meaning.en: keeping in mind the joint beneath the knees
meaning.hi: घुटनों के नीचे के जोड़ का स्मरण करके

meaning.en: and then again the goddess of speech
drawing up from the channel of the generative organ
the wise one, joined with the dot of resonance
of the root centre, best of Brahmins
should hold it in the middle
blazing, hemmed in by the air
for one practising in this way
meaning.hi: इस तरह अभ्यास करने वाले का
वायु पूरी तरह जीत ली जाती है

meaning.en: and the lifting of the body
this is the sign when the fire is mastered
meaning.hi: अग्नि जीतने पर यह लक्षण है

meaning.en: ailments of the lower body are destroyed
the mirror of the mind becomes clear and wondrous
meaning.hi: मन का दर्पण शुद्ध और अद्भुत होता है

meaning.en: then toward the pleasures from Brahma's down
meaning.hi: फिर ब्रह्मा आदि के भोगों से

meaning.en: for one detached from worldly existence
knowledge is the means to complete freedom

meaning.hi: उससे पाप का नाश होता है

meaning.en: the sweet essence of the nectar of knowledge
by whom it has been tasted even once
meaning.hi: जिसने एक बार भी चख लिया

meaning.en: he, letting go of every pursuit
they declare it to be knowledge itself
this world, quite unlike it seems
as made of objects, through ignorance
others of clouded sight see it
meaning.hi: दोषपूर्ण दृष्टि वाले दूसरे देखते हैं

meaning.en: from knowing the true nature of the Self
when ignorance is worn away, most wise one
meaning.hi: अज्ञान क्षीण होने पर, हे महाप्राज्ञ

meaning.en: craving and the rest wear away
when craving and the rest cannot arise, wise one
meaning.hi: राग आदि के न उठने पर, हे प्राज्ञ

meaning.en: one is never again joined to a body
the withdrawal of the senses, great sage
of the senses as they roam
whatever he sees, all of it
meaning.hi: जो कुछ देखता है, वह सब

meaning.en: seeing it as Brahman, with a gathered mind
as declared of old by the knowers of Brahman
one does until the end of life
he should do all of it for Brahman
meaning.hi: वह सब ब्रह्म के लिए करे

meaning.en: with the attitude of worshipping Brahman
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म की आराधना के भाव से

meaning.en: and likewise should perform the wish-fulfilling rites
meaning.hi: और उसी तरह काम्य कर्म करे

meaning.en: or else, drawing in the air
should hold it from place to place
meaning.hi: एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान पर रोके

meaning.en: from the roots of the teeth to the throat
meaning.hi: दाँतों की जड़ से गले तक

meaning.en: the air from the throat to the chest
drawing it on from the chest
should hold it at the navel region
drawing it on from the navel
should hold it at the seat of Kundalini
the wise one, from the seat of Kundalini
should hold it at the root centre
then from the downward breath to the two hips
meaning.hi: फिर अपान से दोनों कूल्हों तक

meaning.en: likewise to the thighs and the middle
meaning.hi: उसी तरह जाँघों और मध्य तक

meaning.en: from there to the two knees and the shanks
meaning.hi: वहाँ से दोनों घुटनों और पिंडलियों तक

meaning.en: should hold it at the big toes
this is declared to be withdrawal
by those who kept the practice in memory, of old
meaning.hi: पहले प्रत्याहार को स्मरण रखने वालों द्वारा

meaning.en: for one joined to such practice
meaning.hi: ऐसे अभ्यास से युक्त के लिए

meaning.en: and the sickness of becoming, you of good vows
drawing the air in through the nostrils
the wise one should fill with air
from the soles of the feet to the head
meaning.hi: पैर के तलवों से सिर तक

meaning.en: afterward, likewise in the two feet
meaning.hi: फिर उसी तरह दोनों पैरों में

meaning.en: and in the same way at the root centre
at the navel-bulb and in the heart's centre
meaning.hi: नाभि-कन्द पर और हृदय के मध्य में

meaning.en: at the base of the throat and at the palate
meaning.hi: कण्ठ की जड़ पर और तालु पर

meaning.en: between the brows and at the forehead
meaning.hi: भौंहों के बीच और माथे पर

meaning.en: and likewise should hold it at the crown
meaning.hi: और उसी तरह शिखर पर धारण करे

meaning.en: the sense of I in the body
the wise one, gathered, drawing it back
by the Self, in the Self
should settle it where there are no opposites and no constructions
directly, by the knowers of Vedanta

meaning.hi: ऐसे अभ्यास करने वाले के लिए

meaning.en: nothing whatever is hard to attain
the five kinds of concentration, you of good vows
in the space within the body
meaning.hi: शरीर के भीतर के आकाश में

meaning.en: likewise the outer wind within the breath
meaning.hi: उसी तरह बाहरी वायु को प्राण में

meaning.en: and fire within the blaze of the belly
meaning.hi: और अग्नि को पेट की ज्वाला में

meaning.en: earth within the earthy part, great sage
meaning.hi: पृथ्वी को पार्थिव भाग में, हे महामुनि

meaning.en: made of the syllables Ha, Ya, Va, Ra, La
meaning.hi: ह, य, व, र, ल अक्षरों वाला

meaning.en: should pronounce the mantra in order
meaning.hi: मन्त्र का क्रम से उच्चारण करे

meaning.en: this concentration is declared the highest
meaning.hi: यह धारणा परम कही गई है
सब पापों को शुद्ध करने वाली

meaning.en: up to the knees is the portion of earth
meaning.hi: घुटनों तक पृथ्वी का अंश है

meaning.en: the portion of water extends to the anus
meaning.hi: जल का अंश गुदा तक कहा गया है

meaning.en: the heart region is the portion of fire
meaning.hi: हृदय का भाग अग्नि का अंश है

meaning.en: the portion of air reaches between the brows
meaning.hi: वायु का अंश भौंहों के बीच तक

meaning.en: and the portion of space, wise one
meaning.hi: और आकाश का अंश, हे प्राज्ञ

meaning.en: is declared the region of the head
meaning.hi: सिर का भाग कहा गया है

meaning.en: and Vishnu likewise in the water portion
meaning.hi: और उसी तरह जल के अंश में विष्णु

meaning.en: and the great lord in the portion of fire
meaning.hi: और अग्नि के अंश में महेशान

meaning.en: and Ishvara in the portion of air
meaning.hi: और वायु के अंश में ईश्वर

meaning.en: in the portion of space, very wise one
meaning.hi: आकाश के अंश में, हे महाप्राज्ञ

meaning.en: or else I shall tell you
on the Person who governs all
Shiva, made of awareness and joy
meaning.hi: चेतना और आनन्द से भरे शिव

meaning.en: the wise one should hold it always
for the cleansing of all sin
meaning.hi: सब पापों की शुद्धि के लिए

meaning.en: the products of creation beginning with Brahma
dissolving each into its own cause
meaning.hi: हर एक को अपने कारण में समेटकर

meaning.en: indescribable, without awareness of its own
directly in the Self that is wholly full
gathering the senses, should join them through the mind to the Self
meaning.hi: इन्द्रियों को समेटकर मन से आत्मा में जोड़े
संसार का नाश करने वाला ध्यान

meaning.en: the cosmic order, the truth, the supreme Brahman
the remedy for all worldly existence
whose vital force flows upward, whose form is the universe
the great Lord with the uncommon eye
with reverence, thinking I am He
meaning.hi: आदर से, वह मैं हूँ ऐसा

meaning.en: should meditate on the lord of the masters of yoga
meaning.hi: योगीश्वरों के ईश्वर का ध्यान करे

meaning.en: or else the real, the Lord

meaning.hi: आदि, मध्य और अन्त से रहित

meaning.en: the Self that is being, awareness and joy
the boundless Brahman, you of good vows
should meditate on it as I am

meaning.hi: ध्यान से परे, मुक्ति के लिए

meaning.en: for one joined to this practice
meaning.hi: इस अभ्यास से युक्त के लिए

meaning.en: step by step, the realised understanding of Vedanta

meaning.hi: भव का नाश करने वाली समाधि

meaning.en: absorption is the dawning of awareness
of the oneness of the supreme and the individual
meaning.hi: परम और जीव की एकता के प्रति

meaning.en: the Self is eternal and everywhere
unchanging like an anvil, free of flaws
being one, it seems divided through error
meaning.hi: एक होते हुए भ्रान्ति से भिन्न दिखता है

meaning.en: through illusion, not in its own nature
no separate world and no round of rebirth
just as space is called the space in a pot
and the space in a hall
so the confused speak of it as two
meaning.hi: वैसे भ्रान्त लोग उसे दो कहते हैं

meaning.en: the Self, as the individual soul and the Lord
meaning.hi: आत्मा, जीव और ईश्वर के रूप में

words.sanskrit: na aham dehah na cha pranah

meaning.en: I am not the body, nor the breath
meaning.hi: मैं न शरीर हूँ, न प्राण

meaning.en: nor the senses, nor the mind
because I am forever of the nature of the witness

meaning.hi: ऐसी जो बुद्धि है, हे मुनिश्रेष्ठ

meaning.en: not one who wanders from birth to birth
never is there anything other than me
as foam, waves and the like, risen from the ocean, again
meaning.hi: जैसे समुद्र से उठे झाग, लहरें आदि फिर

meaning.en: they sink back into the ocean; just so
meaning.hi: समुद्र में लीन होते हैं; वैसे ही

meaning.en: the world dissolves back into me
therefore the mind has no separate existence
and the illusion of a world does not exist
meaning.hi: और जगत् की माया है ही नहीं

meaning.en: for whom this supreme Self, in this way
meaning.hi: जिसके लिए यह परमात्मा इस तरह

meaning.en: has shone forth as the inmost being
he reaches the state of the Person
when pure awareness, in the mind
for the yogi, with nothing in between
meaning.hi: योगी के लिए, बिना व्यवधान के

meaning.en: then he comes into it of himself
meaning.hi: तब अपने आप प्राप्त होता है

meaning.en: he sees within his own Self
meaning.hi: अपने ही आत्मा में देखता है

meaning.en: and the Self in all beings
meaning.hi: और आत्मा को सब प्राणियों में

meaning.en: settled in absorption, he no longer sees as separate
meaning.hi: समाधि में स्थित होकर नहीं देखता

meaning.en: he, having become one with the supreme
meaning.hi: वह परम के साथ एक होकर

meaning.en: alone, as what is ultimately real
the whole world as nothing but illusion
having spoken thus, the blessed one
Sankriti, in his own true nature
abides in happiness, wholly without fear
meaning.hi: सुख से, अत्यन्त निर्भय होकर रहते हैं
